d: Prashant Kishor-Samrat Choudhary : bihar ki rajniti men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur jan suraj ke sansthapak evan vidhayak prashant kishor ki ek mulakat charcha ka vishay ban gaee hai... patna men bijepi ke varishth neta aur purv rajyasbha sansad aarke sinha ki shraddhanjli sabha men donon neta aamne-samne aae... is dauran samrat chaudhri aur prashant kishor ne muskurate hue hath milaya aur kuchh der batchit ki...karyakram ki tasviron men donon neta ek sath sophe par baithe bhi najar aae... unke sath lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary bhi maujud thin... khas bat yah hai ki…
